title: Alfa Wassermann Separation Technologies Ultracentrifuge Pilot Scale, PKII
desc: The PKII has been designed for the specific needs of pilot plants and small scale manufacturing. With a range of linear scalable cores the rotor process volume range can be adjusted from 400 ml to 1.6 liters while retaining the same separation parameters as the KII and PKII 1000 Ultracentrifuge.
